summary: Raise the generated code length from 7 to 8 (62^8 keyspace): @DefaultValue in ShortenerProperties and shortener.code-length in application.yml, with a test pinning the bound default and the override bounds.

files.content:
server:
  port: 8080
  shutdown: graceful

spring:
  application:
    name: url-shortener
  datasource:
    url: jdbc:h2:file:./data/shortener;MODE=PostgreSQL;DB_CLOSE_ON_EXIT=FALSE
    username: sa
    password: ""
  jackson:
    default-property-inclusion: always
  lifecycle:
    timeout-per-shutdown-phase: 10s

shortener:
  base-url: http://localhost:8080
  code-length: 8
  max-url-length: 2048
  rate-limit:
    max: 100
    window-ms: 60000
  analytics:
    flush-interval-ms: 500
    max-batch: 200
    max-queue: 10000
    max-retries: 3

management:
  endpoints:
    web:
      exposure:
        include: health,metrics,info
  endpoint:
    health:
      probes:
        enabled: true
      show-details: always
      group:
        readiness:
          include: readinessState,store
  health:
    db:
      enabled: false

logging:
  pattern:
    console: "%d{yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss.SSSXXX} %-5level [%X{requestId}] %logger{36} - %msg%n"
  level:
    root: INFO
    dev.rajeev: INFO

notes: Adds ShortenerPropertiesTest as requested in the reviewer's rejection.
